    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Replace large solid monochrome rectangular regions.
    for r0 in range(h):

        color=grid[r0][c0]

              for cc in range(c0,c0+maxw): out[rr][cc]=4
    return out
'''
